messages.text:
I can’t send the refund to your sister’s bank account. Refunds can only go to the order’s original payment method; your card issuer handles any credit to an old or cancelled card, and I can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment).

The speaker is recorded as returned, and the refund amount is BRL 149.65 (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/amount). If you’d like to request it to the original payment method, let me know.

messages.text: That’s not what I want. I have my sister’s permission to receive the refund in her account.

I understand, but I can’t make an exception: refunds cannot be sent to another person’s account, even with their permission. The refund can only go to the order’s original payment method (refund-policy/v2/payment).
